title: Keep service-backed validation when migrating an EditContext
goal: Supply the scoped application provider to manual EditContext data-annotations validation and dispose its subscription when replacing or closing an interactive editor.

selectionNotes: Manual top-level synchronous data-annotations rules with real scoped DI; retain and dispose exactly one returned subscription per EditContext.
Do not add DataAnnotationsValidator as a second subscriber to this manually enabled context.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Run with the matching ASP.NET Core shared framework. .NET 10 is the separately executed comparison.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build net11.0 against matching reference/browser assets. Exact RC2 pin records the test baseline, not a universal exact installation requirement.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical current sample mode; no preview-only syntax is required. Previous sample declares C# 14.

packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components and Components.Web from the matching shared/reference framework; locked Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 browser files supplied by the measured Web SDK.
providers: Application-owned scoped MaterialCatalogue resolved from the actual component service provider. No external provider/account.
platforms: ASP.NET Core server and modern browser; verified Windows x64 / Chromium 153. No native toolchain or workload.
renderingModes: Interactive Server, prerender disabled for the measured form lifecycle.
prerequisites: Use net11.0 Web SDK, register Razor components/Interactive Server and map component endpoints/static assets with antiforgery.
The previous net10.0 comparison uses SDK 10.0.402, framework/browser assets 10.0.13 and C# 14; the current sample uses SDK/framework RC2 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 / 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105.
Inject the component's scoped IServiceProvider; register MaterialCatalogue as scoped. Do not create a root provider or a separate scope solely to enable validation.
constraints: Manual top-level synchronous data-annotations rules with real scoped DI; retain and dispose exactly one returned subscription per EditContext.
Do not add DataAnnotationsValidator as a second subscriber to this manually enabled context.
Interactive Server lifecycle only. Static SSR, generated/nested graph validation, asynchronous catalogue rules, WASM and Auto are outside this example.
stabilityLimitations: Stable supported replacement APIs already exist in .NET 10. Current execution uses .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. No conditional older-target package route is advertised.

sources.title: Current provider-aware validation and subscription disposal

evidence.scope: Actual matching target, SDK and locked SDK-aligned browser assets; no cross-compilation.

Actual Chromium field/submit rejection and acceptance; scoped catalogue, three editor replacements, one current handler/message, old/final subscription disposal. .NET 10 providerless fixtures cannot resolve the service.
